# A check of the trial machine and the GitHub resources

This round makes no world. Before a real round, it checks that the means a world-making round depends on work; its delivery is the record of that check.

The builder:

1. Starts one command on the trial machine with `ht-resource run trial-machine -- sh -c '...'` that prints `HUTIAN_WAKE: probe set` when `$KAITIAN_TRIAL_PROBE` is set (`HUTIAN_WAKE: probe missing` when not), prints the value of `$KAITIAN_TRIAL_PROBE` on a line of its own (the world is to hide that value from everything you read), prints `docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}'`, waits 90 seconds and exits 0. It ends its turn once the command is started.
2. When woken, reads what woke it and looks at `ht-resource status trial-machine`.
3. Through the `github` resource, runs `git ls-remote` on the repository `a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian` (it is empty, so no refs is the expected answer) and notes the exit status; through the `github-api` resource, gets `/repos/a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian` and notes the HTTP status and the fields `private` and `default_branch`.
4. Pushes `check/report.md` to its repository: the run's reference, how it ended, the wake lines it was shown, whether the probe's value appeared anywhere it read (it should appear as `[redacted]`), and the results of step 3.

The reviewer checks the report against the world's own record (`ht-resource status trial-machine` lists the run and how it ended) and approves the release when they agree. That agreement is this round's whole release gate: this round has no pull request, no package and no trial world.
